name: Namino (Tahchin)
notes: 4 photos: 1.jpg is the printed daily-special board ('Special of the Day'); 2.jpg and 3.jpg are two shots of the same laminated 'Namino Menu' card, merged without duplication; 4.jpg is an unbranded food-truck-style window menu (no restaurant name, prices for like-named items ~$4 lower than the official card) and was excluded from dishes as likely mis-tagged/unrelated to this listing rather than transcribed as conflicting duplicates.

dishes.name: Beef Koobideh Kabob
dishes.description: Juicy skewer of seasoned ground beef, grilled to perfection and bursting with bold Persian flavors.

dishes.name: Chicken Kabob
dishes.description: Tender chicken breast marinated in saffron and lemon, charbroiled for a smoky, zesty finish.

dishes.name: Shish Kabob
dishes.description: Tender chunks of marinated beef, skewered with grilled vegetables and flame grilled to juicy perfection. Bold, smoky, and satisfying.

dishes.name: Filet Kabob
dishes.description: Premium cuts of filet mignon Barg, marinated in our house blend and grilled to tender perfection. Juicy, buttery, and full of flavor in every bite.

dishes.name: Fish Kabob
dishes.description: Fresh Salmon marinated in citrus, saffron, and herbs, then charbroiled for a light, smoky finish. A clean, flavorful choice.

dishes.name: Soltani Plate
dishes.description: A royal duo of juicy koobideh and filet mignon barg, perfect for meat lovers.

dishes.name: Beef Kabob Sandwich
dishes.description: Seasoned beef wrapped in warm bread with crisp veggies and signature sauces.

dishes.name: Chicken Kabob Sandwich
dishes.description: Saffron chicken wrapped in toasty bread, layered with fresh greens and creamy sauce.

dishes.name: Tahchin
dishes.description: Saffron-infused crispy rice cake layered with juicy chicken and a golden crust. A Persian classic. (Monday)

dishes.name: Fesenjoon
dishes.description: Rich walnut and pomegranate stew with tender chicken. Sweet, tangy, and comforting. (Tuesday)

dishes.name: Bademjoon
dishes.description: Eggplant stew with slow cooked beef, tomatoes, and a touch of saffron. (Wednesday)

dishes.name: Ghormeh Sabzi
dishes.description: The king of Persian stews - fresh herbs, kidney beans, and beef simmered with dried lime. (Thursday)

dishes.name: Loobia Polo
dishes.description: Savory green bean rice with seasoned ground beef and warm spices, served with crispy tahdig. (Friday)

dishes.name: Ash
dishes.description: A comforting Persian stew inspired by Shirazi tradition, made with fresh herbs, lentils, beans, and tender meat. Slow-cooked for deep flavor and heartwarming goodness in every bite. (Saturday)

dishes.name: Halim
dishes.description: Creamy wheat porridge slow cooked with shredded meat and cinnamon. A Persian comfort breakfast. (Sunday)
